A1 gave the label shape to `pull ... against` only. At the driver on W1 the literal reading STOPS an arm (d) run on a parts pass carrying that innocent line while A1's version RUNS it, so the clause I wrote would have cost a run from P4.3's denominator for a reason that is the rig's - fault 24's and 27's own ground.
